scope_change_triggers: Repeating the exact eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: Exact pairing-rank minima for every finite all-pairs five-cube factorization in C=span_F2{1,p,h,k}, where h and k are products of signed coordinate literals on distinct two-element supports; 720 labelled codes, three symmetry classes, all rank caps 0..16.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue starts from the complex eight-term E8 floor. This scoped side result changes the five-cube predecessor from one arbitrary quadratic mask to two signed coordinate-product masks. It does not propose a complex supplier.
bottleneck_link: Tests whether a second nonlinear mask changes copied-information cost or attainable maximum child rank. Rejects the additive-stage format if the optimistic copy bill already has nonpositive deficit; no change to the binding complex supplier is claimed.
stop_rule: Complete the fixed 720-code domain via verified cube-isometry reduction and exact 65536-state certificates; no search beyond this class. Stop research by 2026-10-14T01:42:18Z; reserve final 15 minutes for verification and handoff.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json and independently checked RECEIPT.json: 720 codes, three classes, 675 rational ranks, 55,934,976 edge inequalities; exact cap-14 cost 47 versus best one-mask subcode 48; no new kappa.

seed_use: Seed 44 modulo three is two: examine the opposed-overlap orbit first. All three orbits are completed; the seed does not establish novelty.
optimistic_complete_budget: With all non-copy expenses set to zero, D <= (s-1)*32-s*C <= -32 for every s>=3; the cap-14 opposed construction has C=47 and D<=-32-15s. No physical supplier construction is justified by this budget.
protected_invariant: Every claimed minimum must cover all finite binary words in the explicitly enumerated code, price every dyad by its exact rational pairing rank, and have an attaining word plus a checked lower certificate. Pairing-rank gains are not supplier admission.
failure_modes: Mistaking finite search non-discovery for impossibility.
Silently omitting a dyad, rank cap, code or source/target constraint.
Treating a smaller capped objective as a lower unrestricted copy bill or new kappa.
Generalizing coordinate products to arbitrary quadratic mask pairs.
Trusting generator arithmetic or an unchecked shortest-path result.
